svg.title: The DREAM model family
svg.desc: The connected discs from brand-lab/backgrounds/05-dream-heritage.svg, re-laid out for a web hero. Topology and colours unchanged: GrønREFORM links to the international model, and the chain DREAM to MAKRO to REFORM closes the loop. Sampled from dreamgruppen.dk; the deep green is the international model's own.

g.font-family: Bahnschrift Light, Bahnschrift, Eurostile, Aldrich, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
